name: Drainer Dougie

intro.text: Oi! I've got a contract to drain this moor and I'm draining it. Nobody's told me to stop.
What do you mean, they've gone bust? I've not had a letter. I never get letters up here.

win: Right. Fine. I'll put the spade down. Do I still get paid? I don't, do I.
after: I'm going to retrain. Something indoors. Something dry.
